retainedEvidence.method: Read saved logs and scripts, exact source/artifact hashes, actual installed Docker image/config metadata and staged file metadata. No reviewer rerun of imports, composition, profiles or behavior.

retainedEvidence.profiles: Parsed retained profile JSON: digital_work, shared_provider and public_research agree across candidates. Pre-existing household_research worker_program mismatch remains explicit, not repaired or silently accepted as matching.
retainedEvidence.composition: Saved actual create_runtime_app composition without lifespan reports one real provider-service household loop, actual selected output equal reviewed config, HouseholdProcedureModel wrapper and validator, 4686 current source bytes, current voice/initiative/source authority, runtime readability, no service callback/model/effect.
retainedEvidence.limits: Saved probe evidence consistency is reviewed; no new live household-use or independent repeated execution claim.

installationGuardReview.exactDiff: Build expected config from before by changing precisely two image IDs and two exact opt-in env settings; abort unless equal to candidate.
installationGuardReview.baselineAndStorage: Within receipt lock: verify exact current container images, actual persistent storage and Compose labels/config hash against previous config; verify all fourteen staged module hashes. Candidate Docker Config equals its baseline image Config as independently read.
installationGuardReview.sourceAdmission: Verify staged source/config/review hash, no symlink and exact file uid/gid/mode; rerun exact preinstall composition before activation. Provider _current enforces config matches actual selected household binding, current voice/initiative authorization, reference retention and exact source through current authorized host.
installationGuardReview.activeClaims: Immediately after necessary composition read: query current production namespace in READ ONLY transaction; require zero active nonexpired operational checkpoints except explicitly nonworking memory/scheduled phases, and zero admitted/call_started delegated runs. Then require no component-evaluation child or active component-evaluation container. Any failure aborts before replacement.
installationGuardReview.dispatchAndReplay: Receipt lock and absence of prior receipt required. Persist dispatch_pending then dispatch_result_unknown before the single Compose up. Use no-deps/no-build/pull never, wait for same process to return. Existing receipt prevents automatic repeat after uncertainty.
installationGuardReview.postDispatch: Check exact candidate images, retained storage and exact Compose config binding, then persist running_exact_configuration. This is configuration installation, not demonstrated household behavior.
installationGuardReview.compositionObservation: The selected-output equality is logged; fail-closed _current config-versus-household binding check also enforces the match before dispatch.
installationGuardReview.reviewGate: Coordinator must obtain this exact GO and keep reviewed artifact hashes unchanged before invoking install.py; this report itself performs no deployment.

conditions: Install only the exact candidate images/config/scripts and payload hashes bound here; any changed cause or input requires targeted re-review.
Allow all current source/authority/expiry/claims/component checks to run immediately before replacement; abort rather than interrupt ongoing work or evaluation.
Preserve original NO_GO/error bytes and all unrelated WIP; no broad cleanup or restore/reinstall cycle.
Retain and inspect durable receipt on uncertain dispatch; no automatic retry or action replay.
After root installation distinguish configuration running from actual household use and owner acceptance.
acceptanceLimits: No full E4.15 completion, spontaneous invention, live recognition/greeting/hearing, later use or family acceptance inferred.
No claim that existing household_research mismatch is fixed or able to accept mismatched work.
No new camera/model/household message, test rerun or installation by reviewer.
